metadata.statusNote: Two kinds of point: source 'osm' = OpenStreetMap-mapped features (volunteer-mapped, incomplete; counts are NOT an inventory); source 'bma-dds' = agency-published inventory of the BMA Drainage and Sewerage Department (pump stations and floodgates, 2023 release; drainage pump sumps, 2022 release) with agency coordinates. OSM features that match an official feature (same kind, name match, ≤ 150 m) are kept and carry properties.officialMatch instead of a duplicate point.
metadata.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors; BMA Drainage and Sewerage Department (data.bangkok.go.th)

properties.name: Thai name as tagged (name:th, else name); null if unnamed
properties.kind: pump-station | gate (waterway=sluice_gate|lock_gate|weir|dam|floodgate) | monitoring (water-level station) | retention (basin=retention|detention or แก้มลิง/บ่อหน่วงน้ำ by name) | other (e.g. drainage tunnel by name)
properties.matchedBy: tag rule that selected the feature, or 'name' for Thai/English name-pattern matches
properties.duplicates: other OSM elements with the same kind+name within 150 m that were folded into this point

limitations: OpenStreetMap is volunteer-mapped: completeness and positional accuracy vary; absence of a feature in OSM does not mean absence on the ground.
Names are as tagged in OSM (Thai `name:th` preferred, else `name`); some `name` values are romanised (e.g. 'Klong …') or contain typos.
Coordinates are clipped to the city bbox, simplified with mapshaper (Douglas-Peucker) and rounded to 5 decimals (~1.1 m).
Water-supply pumping stations (pumping_station=water, ประปา/สูบจ่ายน้ำ) are excluded; sewage/wastewater pumping stations are kept as pump-station (tags show pumping_station=*).
flood_prone=yes elements (mostly roads) are counted in metadata.floodProneElementsInBbox but not emitted as points: they are hazard annotations, not infrastructure.

[BMA DDS] Official inventory as published on data.bangkok.go.th (pump stations/floodgates last updated 2023-05; sumps 2022-04); structures built later are missing. Capacities are nominal installed pumping capacities, not simultaneous effective capacity.

[BMA DDS] In the DDS table, DDS labels its pump stations 'บ่อสูบน้ำ'; the total-capacity column is named gp_gate — its meaning (total m³/s) is inferred from the per-pump breakdown, which it matches in nearly all rows.
[BMA DDS] 9 DDS rows have no valid coordinate (e.g. a phone number in the latitude column) and are not mapped; they are listed in data/staged/bangkok-dds-drainage.json.

properties.ddsId: row id in the DDS table (gp_id / sump_id)
properties.ddsType: type as published (บ่อสูบน้ำ / ประตูระบายน้ำ)
properties.capacityM3s: nominal pumping capacity (m³/s) as published; omitted when not published or inconsistent
properties.district: district as published (water-station only)
properties.ddsGroup: DDS operating zone as published (sumps only)
